Conclusions_4_Correlation_Direction: Positive correlation: higher methylation associated with higher expression (opposite of classical dogma)
Conclusions_5_Mechanism_Interpretation: Methylation appears to be a CONSEQUENCE of transcription, not a CAUSE of silencing
